title: Taylor TE10FT 11-Pound Commercial Digital Portion Control Scale, 11 lb (5 kg) in 0.1 oz (1 g) Food and Cooking Scale, Tare and Hold Function, NSF, Stainless Steel Platform
description:
About this item
A PREMIUM CHOICE: Taylor's TE10FT is a rugged, valuable tool in any commercial kitchen, provides accuracy for consistent product portions to maximize profits and increase productivity
ACCURATE WEIGHING: Weigh up to 11 lb (5 kg) in 0.1 oz (1 g) increments, which is ideal for portion control and ensures consistency in food preparation
COMPACT AND CONVENIENT: The compact 5.4" square platform with marine edge accommodates and contains various food items, and is removable for cleaning.
HIGH-QUALITY FEATURES: Recalibratable, tare, HOLD function, which freezes the weight on the scale even when the ingredient is removed
DUAL POWER SUPPLY: The device can be powered by the included AC adapter or AAA batteries, providing flexibility in power sources. The auto-off feature can be disabled when using batteries.
reviews_5s:
Works well for bread making and other tasks. The display is large and easy to read, even with a large bowl on the platform.Works well. Have not had any issues with it & use it often.Great scale. One of the few you can calbrate.I bake a lot. a scale is the only way to go. I defiantly recommend this product.I believe this to be a great scale. Should be working for years to come. The only complaint is the scale is a bit unbalanced. I had to add small pieces of duct tape to one of the rubber feet to stop if from wobbling.

The other complaint is, Sometimes I will be creating recipes and the scale will time out and turn off way too soon. I changed the setting to turn off auto shutoff. But there should be a setting to extend the time the scale will auto turn off.

Other wise I think its a great commercial grade scale.It is reliable. Good quality.Helpful with weighing ingredients for bakingI’ve been using these types of scales in baking for over thirty years. I’ve bought really cheap scales with limited success, and also spent over $120 on scales that don’t perform as well as the Taylor unit.Great scale for home baking or professional kitchen - Taylor makes great reliable products. Order the plug adapter as an extra you can operate on batteries also. Thanks happy baking and cooking:)Not sure why all the bad reviews, but I've been using mine for over 2 years now, and used the same scale professionally in a gelato shop. It's very accurate and I've had zero problems, even with heavy usage. Are people relying on the batteries? Why use batteries when it comes with a cord? I only use it w/cord.
reviews_1s:
This scale will not register quantities less than around 10 grams. I can't measure things like baking soda or salt with it. My cheap scale will weigh them and it seems to be accurate, but not this one. Unacceptable for this price. I bought this based on the recommendation of a well-known YouTube chef. Very disappointed.So I actually meant to order the 22lb version of this scale, but clicked the 11 pound version by mistake I guess. That's ok, my bad, and we really don't weigh anything over 5 pounds anyway. However the reviews on the 22 pound didn't mention how the scales quit working.
Got it last week and immediately started using it daily, maybe 15 times per day. Heaviest thing we have weighed is 2 pounds of pulled pork meat. Today, exactly on the 8th day, it has quit working. Quite a rip off at $61, and of course we have thrown the box away. Believe the other reviews, stay far away from this scale.Scale received is not the one in the picture, Product received is of lower quality and even a different color I been using the one in the picture for years and needed a new one the one I received feels like it will break if you touch itI bought this product on September 15th.
